verdict.rationale: Texas SOS documents that filers can check the status of filings and retrieve them from SOSPortal's My Submissions page, and its homepage links to a "Track Business Filings" feature. However, My Submissions sits inside an MFA-protected account, and the evidence never shows what the tracking feature returns or whether it works without logging in. The Certificate Verification service only confirms that a certificate was issued; it does not track a filing in progress. Missing for 10: evidence of status lookup on public pages without an account, details of the statuses shown, and independent or hands-on confirmation that tracking works.
